title: Annotated Code of Maryland, State Personnel and Pensions Article, Division II - State Retirement and Pension System
source_id: Md. Code, State Pers. & Pens. Division II, Titles 21-38 (beginning at § 21-101)
verified_how: Fetched the section page for Article - State Personnel and Pensions, § 21-101: live text opening 'There is a State Retirement and Pension System', with subsection (b) providing that it delivers benefits to participants and (c) giving it corporate powers and privileges. Served with enactments=false; no as-at date printed.
notes: This is the state-law layer (the Maryland State Retirement and Pension System, covering State employees, teachers, State police, judges and participating governmental units). Federal OASDI is 42 U.S.C. ch.7 and private occupational pensions are pre-empted by ERISA (29 U.S.C. 1001).
